Solves complex math equations easily with the help of advanced scientific functions, or quickly calculates simple basic calculations. It is fast, handy, and has big buttons!
Explicitly designed for iPad, and now also available on iPhone!
Save time and share your calculation with your colleague, friend, or anyone, whenever you are!
Master your work and calculate percentages to check your business expenses, taxes, financial reports, and whether your budget is correct! #homework #school #hybrid #home

CALCULATOR - EXCLUSIVELY MADE FOR YOU
- Basic & Scientific Calculator in One View
- Advanced Scientific Functions
- Live Currency Converter; get exchange rate prices
- History; Track and save all calculations, taxes, and expenses
- Copy Result, Complete Equation & Share Calculations
- Equation edit function
- Memory Banks
- Calculate with Degrees or Radians
- Available on iPad & iPhone
- Rotation
- Multitasking Support

AD-FREE CALCULATOR
